APPROVE
The extracted helpers keep the same control flow and error recording. The `break` in `ReadEntries` still falls through to enqueuing subdirectories, and the `while` guard still caps at `maxFiles`, so `Files` drops well under 15 with no behaviour change. I couldn't find the repo to build it, though, and the removed blank line after the early-return `}` could trip SA1513 if StyleCop is enforced.
